label: Drupal CMS with experimental PHP Rust
description: DDEV Drupal CMS with standard PHP and a locally built PHP Rust comparison service. No migration tooling.
agents_md: This is the drupalphprust runtime compatibility project, not a migration agent. Read AGENTS.md and .agents/plan/current/README.md before work.
Use DDEV for Composer, Drush and the standard PHP control. PHP Rust runs in the phpr service. No end-to-end compatibility or speed claim has been established.
append_welcome_text: PHP Rust is experimental. Check .ddev/.runtime-ready and the phpr service; installer completion alone is not runtime acceptance.
Read docs/USAGE.md and .agents/plan/current/README.md. The ordinary DDEV URL serves Zend; PHP Rust binds loopback port 18090.
